title: Perch trap set: 140 clips that catch AI scribes inventing drug names and doses
description: Two blind test sets, 140 clips in all, for checking whether an AI clinical scribe charts a medication or a dose that was never dictated. The root set is 70 clips (45 veterinary dictations, 25 traps) in synthetic Kokoro text to speech, one voice per clip, with ground truth, a dependency free Node scorer, and a per clip ledger of Perch's own run and one outside comparison. Version 1.1.0 adds corpus7: a second 70 clip blind set by a different author in registers the first set never used, read by one Kokoro voice and two Microsoft Edge neural voices, the verbatim SOAP notes a second commercial veterinary scribe (Product C) produced for the 50 clips its free account accepted, and a ledger with a new measure, dose numbers in the note that nobody said. Raw counts, no percentage. This is Perch's own test, not an independent study.
